The *Ākāsaṅgapañha* ("Question on the Qualities of Space") is a discourse located in the seventh chapter of the *Milindapañha* [catalog record; SuttaCentral]. The text discusses spiritual qualities illustrated by the simile or characteristics of space (*ākāsa*), a theme associated in the SuttaCentral catalog with the *Mahārāhulovāda Sutta* (MN 62, PTS MN i 420) of the *Majjhima Nikāya* [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral records three modern translations of the text across three languages [SuttaCentral].

No matches meeting the threshold score are recorded for cross-language parallels in Chinese, Sanskrit, or Tibetan [DharmaNexus]. However, automated text-reuse analysis by DharmaNexus identifies substantial Pali-internal reuse, indicating 354 matching passages shared across 50 Pali texts [DharmaNexus].
